user_reviews.title: Fun to drive and comfortable
user_reviews.author: Ritom Borah
user_reviews.text: I've owned the Kia Sonet for several months, and it's been a great experience overall. The car looks stylish, feels premium inside, and comes loaded with features. The engine is smooth, fuel efficiency is good, and it's very easy to drive in city traffic. The infotainment system and comfort features make every journey enjoyable.

user_reviews.title: Performance that beats estimates
user_reviews.author: Deep Mukherjee
user_reviews.text: Have been using this for the last 3 years and drove over 40000 kms, including multiple long rides. The best thing about this car is its performance and comfort during long drives. Features are totally value for money, and the service experience is good too, coming from a previous Maruti owner. I have got mileage higher than ARAI mileage in this car and have got 18-19 with ac on, long rides too, at an average speed of 70-80.

user_reviews.title: Budget worthy Car
user_reviews.author: Carwale User
user_reviews.text: On the highway, it delivers an impressive fuel economy of 15–17 kmpl alongside a silent and smooth ride, though you must compromise on city mileage, which drops to around 7–10 kmpl. Aside from this, it stands out as the best in its class for infotainment, air conditioning, and interior finishes compared to other vehicles in the same price range.

user_reviews.title: Infotainment Issue
user_reviews.author: ARPIT
user_reviews.text: Car is good.... but infotainment issue is there... Suddenly after three years touch is not working.... generally there should not be an issue with infotainment, but when I visited center, they checked the issue and told there is no issue of water or anything, it is just an electric thing and it needs to be replaced ... as a goodwill gesture we will give 50% discount, but still you need to pay 25k, if this is an issue from there side, Why I need to pay... if issue comes for 1% car , I can agree but Aman Kia hinjewadi service manager itself told, 5 cars out of 20 are facing this issue in their area, that means it a lot manufacturing issue, why they didnt call out all cars and fixed this .. its issue from their side, and still they are convincing customer to go for 50% discount as a goodwill gesture, as a goodwill, they need to do it free of cost ...... For this reason, I suggest not to go for Kia as their is an issue with their infotainment, and it includes a lot of maintenance every two years .....like almost 40 to 50k every 2 to 3 years. There are lot of reviews can be read from fb group and google reviews as lots of people facing the same issue

user_reviews.title: Excellent Driving feel
user_reviews.author: Jayesh Tiwari
user_reviews.text:
Bought a Kia 1 month back and driven it 500kms till now, and I must tell you the driving experience is awesome. I have driven 3XO and Nexon, but this one is the most comfortable driving possible. It has a good and unique design that people notice on the street, interior is designed to keep everything sleek and fancy.
I don't know why people have problems with the suspension of Sonet. I personally find it very comfortable.
Driving AT Diseal didn't give me any power issues, in fact, in sports mode it flies like a rocket.
Wireless charging, safety features like auto local unlock as per speed and front back sensors, sunroof, auto stop mode of traffic, let's you have all the premium features at just 13-14 lakhs, which is awesome.
My friend has a high model and he is jealous of me.
I find it a good buy for a family car

user_reviews.title: Bought the Kia Sonet, Regret the Decision
user_reviews.author: Hiten
user_reviews.text:
I bought the Kia Sonet expecting a comfortable and tech-friendly car, but honestly, it hasn’t lived up to the hype. The first and biggest issue is comfort. The suspension is quite stiff, and you feel almost every bump on bad roads. City driving itself becomes tiring, and long drives are even worse. The seats look premium but lack proper cushioning, especially for the thighs. Rear seat comfort is poor, and three adults at the back feel cramped very quickly.

The ADAS features were another major disappointment. On paper, they sound impressive, but in real Indian traffic conditions, they don’t work smoothly. Sometimes the warnings are too sensitive and annoying, and other times they fail to react when you actually expect them to. Instead of feeling safer, it often feels distracting and unreliable.

Road noise and engine noise are clearly noticeable at higher speeds, which ruins the driving experience. For a car priced in the premium compact SUV segment, this level of refinement is not acceptable. Overall, Kia Sonet feels more focused on looks and features than real comfort and usability. I expected much better value for the price paid and wouldn’t recommend it to someone who prioritizes comfort and practical safety features.

Engine performance is great. Very smooth driving experience with a diesel engine of SONET. The same engine is being used with Creta and Seltos as well. It's the most value-for-money model so far. The seats are good. Suspension is very fine. You may travel long distances without any tiredness.
